scope: Design research, not implementation or a measured conversion audit

references.name: Jitter
references.borrow: Large, clear typography; an obvious first action; product examples that show the result of using the tool.
references.ppq: Lead with model choice and pay-per-use, keep the prompt entry visible, then show one short sequence inside the real PPQ interface.
references.limit: Borrow the hierarchy and purposeful motion. Keep PPQ’s own orange accent and typography.
references.version: The award is for the 2025 version; the current homepage has since added AI positioning.

references.name: Weavy → Figma Weave
references.borrow: Models and tools are presented through a coherent creative workflow, with examples that make the breadth tangible.
references.ppq: Show a single task across PPQ’s model choices, or one prompt with side-by-side answers. Organize secondary examples by Chat, Image, Video and Voice.
references.limit: A node editor would suggest a capability PPQ does not offer. Translate the storytelling into PPQ’s existing interface.
references.version: The winning site was Weavy. Its original domain now redirects to Figma Weave.

references.name: Cerebrium
references.borrow: A technically credible narrative, visible use cases, usage-based pricing, and a pricing calculator highlighted in the award entry.
references.ppq: Give users understandable cost examples and a route into the model catalog. Present API access as a concise second path, with integrations and documentation.
references.limit: Adapt the pricing presentation to prompts and model usage. GPU-compute units and an enterprise sales journey would add complexity for PPQ visitors.
references.version: Reviewed the current homepage and pricing page, alongside the 2026 award entry.

references.name: Reflect
references.borrow: The award visual frames the app as the central object. The current page also gives privacy and local storage dedicated space.
references.ppq: Use a legible close-up of the model picker, estimated cost and privacy badges, then explain the privacy choices with a short dedicated section.
references.limit: Keep PPQ’s charcoal and orange. The purple glow is not needed to achieve the same focus. The privacy claims must remain specific to each PPQ tier.
references.version: Honorable Mention, not Site of the Day. The current Reflect product and copy differ from the 2023 entry.

references.name: Luma Dream Machine
references.borrow: A cinematic presentation of generated work makes creative possibilities immediately visible.
references.ppq: Replace generic media feature cards with a small curated gallery made using PPQ. Attach the prompt, model and actual cost where verified.
references.limit: Use this for a contained media section. A full-page video opening would delay PPQ’s chat and pricing story.
references.version: The award-entry URL now redirects to Luma’s newer app marketing page. Study the recorded winning version for this reference.

references.name: Cleo AI
references.borrow: Conversational language and visible chat exchanges connect AI capabilities to recognizable everyday needs.
references.ppq: Use concrete prompts and short answer examples so a first-time visitor can immediately see what they could do.
references.limit: PPQ should retain a calm, capable voice. Cleo’s persona, financial framing and elaborate scenery are specific to its own product.
references.version: Reviewed the current site and 2026 award-entry imagery.

recommendation: Jitter for the structure, Weavy for the model breadth story, Cerebrium for usage-based pricing and developer access
proposedSections: Communicate access to many models, usage-based payment and no required registration. Keep a working prompt entry and a clear way to open the app.
Show one prompt, side-by-side model answers, the model selector and cost information. Use real PPQ components and a readable crop.
Show how top-up and spending work, with representative examples tied to current model rates and assumptions. Link to the full catalog.
Offer a compact set of Chat, Image, Video and Voice examples. Use generated outputs with model names and measured costs where available.
Distinguish anonymous access, zero data retention and end-to-end encrypted model options. Link to PPQ’s detailed explanation.
A compact API section with recognizable integrations; credible user evidence; a short FAQ; repeat the primary action. Keep Whisper as a connected product link.
